name: exa-search
description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on r
author: K-Dense-AI
summary_zh: 面向科研与技术内容的网页搜索和提取工具，适合语义检索、学术筛选及批量抓取网页和论文。
